visual_description: A high-tech handheld scanner being held by a field researcher. The device emits a glowing cyan laser grid over a dinosaur trackway in the sandstone. A built-in screen shows a thermal-style depth map of the impression. The researcher wears a rugged canvas field jacket and protective gloves.

constraints.logic: Used for non-invasive site documentation and 3D reconstruction of trackways.
constraints.background: Arid, sun-drenched canyon with layered sedimentary rock.
